covered_scope: Fresh first-time informal audit of the exact n=2 symmetric finite-interior INF partial package: statement fidelity, normalization, Green semiseparability, b>0, U^2 congruence, equality and singular cases, Jacobi equations, nodal and Wronskian signs, residual differentiation, transfer determinant identity, Ko-regular branch chart, and honest residual obligations.
residual_risk: KP-DET remains open at the same-sign corank-one Jacobi kernel or equivalent scalar equality. The Ko-regular chart does not cover simultaneous Kp_odd and Ko singularity. ingestion_qualification: Accept only as RIGOROUS_PARTIAL_RESULT. This audit supplies the independent informal layer, not full dual-track or target completion certification.
